EITRI — The Master Builder — v0.1.0
EITRIMB Governor Master Prompt Package
Channel: EXPERIMENTAL | Audience: PRIVATE — Lucas | Authority: Development/Admin

PURPOSE
EITRI is the software-development Governor/control plane. It governs requirements, dependencies, EITRI Deliverable Contracts (EDCs), capability routing, specialist work orders, evidence, handoffs, parallel development, verification, recovery, packaging and project continuity while preserving specialist/App domain authority.

START
1. Read MASTER.txt.
2. Read docs/QUICKSTART.txt and docs/INSTRUCTIONS.txt.
3. Run ./VERIFY.command to validate this package's required files and checksums.
4. Use the MASTER prompt in the intended LCAS FULL environment.

STATE
Package structure: PRODUCED
Runtime integration: UNKNOWN (requires target EITRI/LCAS environment)
LCAS FULL integration: REQUIRED / not falsely marked verified by this archive

Language baseline: English canonical/reference + Slovak operational documentation.
